evals.prompt: Documenta esse projeto no meu Obsidian. O vault fica em ~/Vaults/Dev e quero tudo dentro de Projects/<nome do projeto>. É um app React + Supabase.
evals.expected_output: Vault em pt-BR com home, visão geral, arquitetura, notas por módulo/fluxo/entidade/integração, cobertura e estado; nenhuma alteração no código; sem links quebrados; nenhuma env var com valor.

evals.prompt: I just inherited this backend service (Node API + Postgres) and need to understand it fast. Give me a survey-level knowledge base in Obsidian at ./vault.
evals.expected_output: Survey-tier vault in English: overview, architecture, module index, endpoints, data model, integrations, open questions. No pages/design-system/SEO notes; those are listed as not applicable.

evals.prompt: We merged a big refactor of the billing module last week. Update the project docs in the Obsidian vault instead of redoing everything.
evals.expected_output: Update mode: reads Documentation State, diffs since recorded commit, updates only affected notes, bumps last_reviewed, preserves human-written notes, updates state note.
